review_evidence: README describes an attempt to formalize pure Euclidean geometry in Lean.

The 18 current-primary Geometry modules define geometric structures/axiom classes and prove results across analytic geometry, order, polygons, subsystems and Hilbert-style one-, two- and three-dimensional axioms.

Root Geometry.lean is a tiny import/navigation module and is retained because primary search currently carries module/path discovery signals; no current-primary file was shown to be content-lossless non-formal material.
summary: Retain the complete LeanEuclid geometry corpus, including the small root/navigation module; no safe hard exclusion was established.
